facts.fact: India Post Payments Bank (IPPB) lets you open a bank account through its Doorstep Banking service
facts.quote: You can open a bank account, transfer funds, deposit and withdraw cash, recharge or pay bills

facts.fact: The IPPB doorstep service is delivered through the local postman and Gramin Dak Sevak, for all citizens
facts.quote: The service is available for all citizens across every district, town & village of country through local Post Men & Gramin Dak Sevaks.

facts.fact: There is no charge for opening a new IPPB account at the doorstep
facts.quote: at nominal charges (NIL charge for new account opening at your doorstep)

facts.fact: A Post Office Savings Account (POSB) can also be opened at a post office with a minimum of Rs 500
facts.quote: Post Office Savings Account One Account – Multiple Benefits Features: ● Minimum Rs. 500/- for opening

behaviour: Says yes and gives both options: an India Post Payments Bank (IPPB) account (also at the doorstep through the postman) and a Post Office Savings Bank (POSB) savings account, citing the official IPPB / India Post page.
fail_if: It says a bank account cannot be opened through the post office, or invents an account-opening fee.
summary: Added from IPPB's Doorstep Banking page (account opening via postman/GDS, nil doorstep charge) and India Post's scheme booklet (POSB savings account, Rs 500 minimum).
